findings: No difference found in Entity.checkWaterCollisions -> World.applyLiquidDrag -> LiquidBlock.applyMaterialDrag/getFlow for 1.11 vs 1.11.1. Scan bounds use floor(min) and ceil(max), with maxima exclusive in cell loops; loaded area bounds include shifted chunk maxima. Per-cell and aggregate normalization/0.014 impulse match.

Scope correction: LocalClientPlayerEntity.tick calls world.isChunkLoaded(BlockPos), whose World overload delegates with allowEmpty=true; ClientWorld.isChunkLoadedAt returns allowEmpty || !chunk.isEmpty(). Therefore the method is not a nonempty-loaded-chunk gate. World.applyLiquidDrag also invokes isAreaLoaded(..., true), so the client empty-chunk path is admitted.

Source attribution correction: PlayerEntity overrides Entity.hasLiquidCollision() as !abilities.flying. It is true for the bounded nonflying player case, but is not the inherited Entity default. The comparison should cite the PlayerEntity override.
